text:
Iron(III) chloride, FeCl3, is a brown solid.
What is the meaning of (III) in the name?
A
It is the amount of energy released when the compound was formed.
B
It is the rate of the reaction that formed this compound.
C
It is how many atoms of iron are bonded together in the compound.
D
It is the oxidation number of iron in the compound.

options.label: A
